supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: significant extension of the brow ridge boundary beyond the outer corner of the eye visible in profile

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: high contrast; muzzle region displays significantly lighter pixel intensity relative to the dark periocular and cheek regions
